name: house-rules
description: Checks goal-checklist strips, and optionally the closing status line and the conventional-commit title rule.

checkStatusLine.title: Check the closing status line
checkStatusLine.description: Warn when a reply does not end on a 🟢/🟡/🔴 status line of 100 characters or fewer.

enforceCommitRule.title: Enforce the commit and PR title rule
enforceCommitRule.description: Block git commit and gh pr create unless the subject is type(scope): summary, 50 characters or fewer, lowercase after the colon, no trailing period.
